newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Act NZ urges National vote for Auckland Central.
newsitem.headline: Act NZ urges National vote for Auckland Central.

text.p: Act New Zealand Party leader Richard Prebble on Thursday urged voters in Auckland Central, where Act candidate Rodney Hide is standing, to cast their vote for National's Shane Frith.
Prebble told a final pre-election rally in Auckland that present polling put Frith neck-and-neck with Labour's Judith Tizard and that with Act's eight percent support he would win.

"The way to get Rodney Hide into Parliament is to vote for Shane Frith, the National candidate for Auckland Central, and to vote Act on the list," Prebble said. "On present polling that will put Rodney Hide into Parliament," he said.
Act is urging voters to vote National in their constituency and Act on the Party list, with the exception of Wellington Central, where Prebble himself is standing and polling strongly.

Prebble said that unlike Act and National, a Labour-NZ First-Alliance coalition would not be able to agree on a budget. "A vote for the left is a vote for instability and another election within six months," he told a crowd of around 200.
